moments.evidence: Una bota té fang enganxat a la sola. Una estora clara és neta.
Planta la bota a l’estora. El fang entra en contacte amb les fibres per sota de la sola.
Aixeca el peu i deixa visible la petjada amb el mateix dibuix de la sola. Part del fang resta a la bota.

continuity.anchor: Un parell de botes amb tres tacs amples a cada sola i una estora clara amb rivet.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic monkey; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Una bota té fang enganxat a la sola. Una estora clara és neta. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Planta la bota a l’estora. El fang entra en contacte amb les fibres per sota de la sola. RIGHT result: Aixeca el peu i deixa visible la petjada amb el mateix dibuix de la sola. Part del fang resta a la bota. Continuity and accounting: Un parell de botes amb tres tacs amples a cada sola i una estora clara amb rivet. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: La sola recolzada apunta cap a la dreta, però els tres tacs impresos queden alineats com si la bota estigués girada. Cal fer coincidir l’orientació de la bota amb la petjada.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic monkey; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Una bota té fang enganxat a la sola. Una estora clara és neta. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Planta la bota a l’estora. El fang entra en contacte amb les fibres per sota de la sola. RIGHT result: Aixeca el peu i deixa visible la petjada amb el mateix dibuix de la sola. Part del fang resta a la bota. Continuity and accounting: Un parell de botes amb tres tacs amples a cada sola i una estora clara amb rivet. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Fixed SIDE view of boots. The sole and the footprint must share the identical orientation: toes always point to the RIGHT side of the image. Three broad transverse mud treads therefore make three side-by-side individual muddy marks forming an elongated horizontal toe-right single footprint. Lower the boot slowly, then lift vertically keeping its toe to the right. Keep the mat orientation fixed and the shape of the footprint proportional to the existing boot sole. No other place items.
